hypothesis: Short-term mean reversion in established pump.fun memecoins trading on PumpSwap: buying after a >5% drop over 1 hour and holding 4 hours beats random entries in the same pools, net of costs.

costs.impact: size / (liquidity_usd / 2) per side, liquidity as registered
costs.note: PumpSwap charges ~0.30%/side (LP + protocol + creator); 0.50% leaves room for routing and priority fees

universe.selection: GeckoTerminal solana dex 'pumpswap' pools by 24h volume, pages 1-10; SOL-quoted; one pool per token (the busiest); liquidity >= $50k; 24h volume >= $100k; age >= 2 days; as of registered_at. Registered before collecting or looking at any of these pools' data.

evaluation.period: from registered_at to the evaluation date (at least 7 days later); only bars after registered_at
evaluation.data: 5-minute OHLCV (USD) from GeckoTerminal for every registered pool, including pools that lost liquidity or died (their history stays available)
evaluation.primary: mean of (trade net return - mean net return of entering the same pool at every bar of the period with the same hold), over all trades; 90% CI by pool bootstrap
evaluation.success: primary excess > 0 with the 90% CI above 0, AND mean net return per trade > 0
evaluation.script: handoff/experiments/established_rules.py (fixed config) on data fetched after the period

in_sample_result: none yet for this universe (registered first). v1's in-sample result came from a different, mixed universe.
